[[Zarnas' Wrath]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Zarnas Stonewrath]], a [[boss]] in [[Arborstone (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage|Earth Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Earth Magic]])
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of Earth Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Golden Pillar]] [[dye]]d green.

The color of Zarnas' Wrath was changed slightly at an unknown time (around the end of 2006). It may be that one Zarnas' Wrath is a slightly different shade of green than another Zarnas' Wrath. The green of the newer object is slightly stronger as the original.

*[[Perfect]] [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription
